author: anon-df5e95db
content: Both BCF HeaderView (id_cache) and BAM HeaderView (planned tid_cache) use HashMap<Vec<u8>, i32/u32> where each key is a separate heap allocation. For headers with thousands of entries (e.g., GRCh38 contigs), this creates many small allocations. Consider: (1) single contiguous Vec<u8> buffer with NUL-separated names + HashMap<Range<usize>, id> referencing offsets, (2) string interning crate, or (3) sorted Vec with binary search for small dictionaries.
